# Features

What re-psn does today and what is planned, one row per feature. Each status rests on the evidence next to it: a test in this repository, a recorded run in the docs, or the pull request that added it. *Not yet verified* means the code or config is in the repository but nothing here checks it. *Since* is the version that first had the feature; *main* means merged but not in a release yet.

| Status | Meaning | Features |
|---|---|---|
| available | merged, with a test or a recorded run | 43 |
| not yet verified | merged, but nothing in the repository checks it | 3 |
| partial | merged in part, or with known gaps | 9 |
| in progress | an open pull request or branch | 0 |
| planned | wanted and intended, not started | 15 |
| later | after the planned items, or after a decision | 9 |
| declined | will not be done | 1 |
| all | | 80 |

## Rooms and matchmaking

| ID | Feature | Status | Since | Evidence | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rooms-basic` | **Rooms and search**: Create, search, join and leave rooms modelled on sceNpMatching2. A search sees only the rooms of its own title, with each room's external data. Room messages, owner kicks, owner handoff when the owner leaves, and member pushes with each peer's address and P2P port. | available | 0.1.0 | [`server/rooms.go`](../server/rooms.go), [`TestRooms`](../server/server_test.go), [`TestRoomKick`](../server/kick_test.go), [`TestRoomKickDispatchOrder`](../server/kick_test.go) | Upstream work. `KICK_MEMBER` removes a member but does not prevent rejoining. |
| `rooms-data` | **Room and member data**: External and internal room data (only the owner writes it), room flags that searchers see (`SET_ROOM_DATA` which 2), and member data sent with `CREATE_ROOM` and `JOIN_ROOM` and returned in every member entry. | available | 0.2.0 | [`server/rooms.go`](../server/rooms.go), [`TestRooms`](../server/server_test.go) | External and internal data are upstream work (0.1.0). With `site/terminal.js` (no dependencies) the page becomes a terminal-style interface: menu, content and a command line with the commands `features`, `roadmap`, `settings`, `install`, `connect`, `changelog`, `docs` and more, suggestions while typing (a dimmed completion and a list of up to eight matches, taken with Tab, Right arrow, Enter or a tap), Tab completion, history, a dark and a light theme chosen with a System / Light / Dark switch in the header or the `theme` command (the same choice, remembered in the browser), colour from the full gruvbox-material palette with every text colour checked at 4.5:1 or more, and scrolling tabs and tappable chips on a phone (a phone starts in the plain view); the same page works without script, and a plain view link switches the interface off. No third-party loads, a content security policy that allows only this site, and the colours of the README art. `pages.yml` deploys `site/` to GitHub Pages.
